function: Excluded as above_phy: the DQN learns task offloading and user association (p. 10); transmit power control and computing resource allocation are solved by SCA/CVX, not learned (pp. 8-9, 11).
notes: Reason above_phy. Abstract p. 1: 'decomposes the original problem into two subproblems, which are solved by successive convex approximation (SCA) and deep reinforcement learning (DRL)'. Page 10: the DQN action is {rho_m, beta_m,1..N, Pi_m}, that is the offloading decision, user association and offloading destination (Eq. 43), and 'P3.1 is a complex multi-constrained 0-1 integer optimization problem ... this paper proposes a DRL-based solution'. Power p* and computing f* come from SCA and convex optimization via CVX (Section V.B and V.C, pp. 8-9; Algorithm 2, p. 11) and enter the DQN only as state (Eq. 42, p. 10). No physical-layer decision is learned, so the work does not pass the above_phy check. The PDF is the paper of the DOI: title and DOI on p. 1.
